prompt: Repair parallel phase execution so a dependent child starts only after its prerequisites succeed and receives their completed output as context. Preserve caller-visible result ordering. Do not modify tests.
rationale: Dependency readiness without transferring completed prerequisite output can silently produce context-free downstream work.

prompt: Repair worker receipt ownership checks so a grant for one project subtree does not authorize a sibling whose name merely shares its prefix. Preserve exact-path and nested-subtree grants, and reject scope expansion beyond the supervisor assignment. Do not modify tests.
rationale: A lexical prefix check without a directory boundary grants unintended sibling write scope.

prompt: Repair gate evidence reuse at the configured maximum-age boundary: otherwise-valid evidence remains reusable exactly at the limit, while older evidence requires a fresh check. Preserve the other validity and completeness conditions. Do not modify tests.
rationale: Inclusive freshness windows are vulnerable to comparator regressions that trigger unnecessary verification work.

prompt: Repair change classification so even one security or data path selects the security/data class, including changes that also span multiple modules. Keep documentation-only, UI-only, empty, and ordinary change classifications intact. Do not modify tests.
rationale: A single sensitive path must be sufficient to require the appropriate safety gates; file count is not a safety exemption.

prompt: Repair configuration path validation so operations refuse an autopus.yaml that is a symbolic link and leave its external target untouched. Preserve normal configuration handling and read-only preview behavior. Do not modify tests.
rationale: Following a symbolic link while trying to detect it can permit configuration reads and writes outside the intended project boundary.

prompt: Repair OpenCode plugin configuration merging so an existing local file-URL declaration and the equivalent managed project path identify the same plugin. Do not duplicate that registration, and preserve the proper V1 versus V2 configuration shape. Do not modify tests.
rationale: Treating file URLs and filesystem paths as unrelated identities produces duplicate plugin registrations during harness updates.
